title: Russian Beef Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting Russian-inspired dish made with ground beef, toasted casserole, and a hint of flavor.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the toasted casserole to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the beef broth, milk, and Russian seasoning. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the beaten egg and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the lightly salted ground beef breadcrumbs.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
